mapper.select:
SELECT m.seqMember, m.nickname, m.pic, m.gender, m.intro, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, m.birth) / 12) AS age, p.mbti, p.smoking, p.drinking, p.travelType, p.stepCount, p.coverPic,
(SELECT LISTAGG(s.Name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.seqStay) FROM profile_stay ps JOIN stay s ON ps.seqStay = s.seqStay WHERE ps.seqMember = m.seqMember) AS stayNames,
(SELECT LISTAGG(l.Name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.seqLanguage) FROM profile_language pl JOIN language l ON pl.seqLanguage = l.seqLanguage WHERE pl.seqMember = m.seqMember) AS languageNames,
(SELECT LISTAGG(a.Name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.seqAgeGroup) FROM profile_age_group pa JOIN age_group a ON pa.seqAgeGroup = a.seqAgeGroup WHERE pa.seqMember = m.seqMember) AS ageGroupNames,
( (CASE WHEN p.mbti = my.mbti THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN p.smoking = my.smoking THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN p.drinking = my.drinking THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN p.travelType = my.travelType THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN p.stepCount = my.stepCount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profile_stay ps1 JOIN profile_stay ps2 ON ps1.seqStay = ps2.seqStay WHERE ps1.seqMember = m.seqMember AND ps2.seqMember = #{loginSeq}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profile_language pl1 JOIN profile_language pl2 ON pl1.seqLanguage = pl2.seqLanguage WHERE pl1.seqMember = m.seqMember AND pl2.seqMember = #{loginSeq}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profile_age_group pag1 JOIN profile_age_group pag2 ON pag1.seqAgeGroup = pag2.seqAgeGroup WHERE pag1.seqMember = m.seqMember AND pag2.seqMember = #{loginSeq}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS matchCount
FROM member m JOIN profile p ON m.seqMember = p.seqMember CROSS JOIN (SELECT * FROM profile WHERE seqMember = #{loginSeq}) my WHERE m.seqMember = #{targetSeq}
